# AITERRA — סוכנות שיווק דיגיטלי ובניית אתרים | Digital Marketing & Web Development Agency

> Aiterra (styled AITERRA in the wordmark) is a full-stack digital agency based in Bat Yam, Israel (serving Bat Yam, Holon, Tel Aviv and the Gush Dan / central region). It builds high-performance websites and online stores, runs organic SEO and GEO/AEO, manages paid advertising (Google, Facebook, Instagram), and delivers business automation (with and without AI), AI agents, CRM integrations and WhatsApp bots for small and medium Israeli businesses. The team works in Hebrew, English and Russian. Primary language of the site: Hebrew (he, RTL). A full English version exists under /en.

## Services / שירותים
- [בניית אתרים / Web Development](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/web-development): Business sites and custom web systems in clean, fast, conversion-focused code (React/Next.js). Code ownership is handed over on delivery. English: /en/services/web-development
- [אתר תדמית / Brochure Sites](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/brochure): Positioning, structure, design and copy for a business site whose job is to produce enquiries. English: /en/services/brochure
- [קידום אתרים אורגני / SEO](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/seo): Technical SEO, content strategy, local SEO and link building for stable organic traffic. Includes GEO/AEO (visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews). English: /en/services/seo
- [חנות אינטרנטית / E-commerce](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/ecommerce): Online stores built in code — catalogue, checkout, Israeli payment and invoicing integrations, inventory and order management. English: /en/services/ecommerce
- [פיתוח מערכות / Custom Development](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/development): Custom platforms, client portals, dashboards, CRM/ERP builds, mobile and web apps and system integrations in Next.js, Node and PostgreSQL. English: /en/services/development
- [אוטומציה לעסקים / Business Automation](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/automation): Business process automation for Israeli SMBs: lead routing from the website, WhatsApp and ad campaigns into the CRM, WhatsApp bots and first response, quotes, invoices and payment reminders through Morning (חשבונית ירוקה), iCount, Rivhit, חשבשבת or Priority, order/inventory/shipping sync, automated reports and alerts. Built on Make, n8n or custom code over the systems' APIs; AI is used where free text must be understood, every AI output is validated by a rule before it changes a record. Every run is logged and monitored after launch. Typical setup from about 3,000 ILS; tools 150-800 ILS/month. English: /en/services/automation
- [סוכני AI / AI Agents](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/ai-agents): AI agents (סוכני בינה מלאכותית) that answer customers in Hebrew from the business's own content only (price list, terms, catalogue) and act inside existing systems: open a lead, book a meeting, check an order status. Written guardrails against invented answers, permission-scoped actions, full logging and handoff to a person with the transcript. Connected to WhatsApp Business, website chat, CRM, calendar and Israeli invoicing. English: /en/services/ai-agents
- [קידום ב-AI / GEO and AI search visibility](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/ai-search): Generative Engine Optimization (קידום בבינה מלאכותית): entity definition and schema, citable content, presence in the sources AI engines read, and a monthly visibility report for ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. English: /en/services/ai-search
- [תחזוקת אתרים / Website Maintenance](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/maintenance): Monthly maintenance packages with published pricing and written response and fix times (SLA), security updates, backups, monitoring, IS 5568 accessibility checks and Israeli integration upkeep. Also for sites Aiterra did not build. English: /en/services/maintenance
- [שיווק ופרסום ממומן / Paid Advertising](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/marketing): Google Ads and Meta campaign management, creative production and landing pages, reported on cost per lead. English: /en/services/marketing
- [מיתוג ועיצוב / Brand & UX/UI](https://www.aiterra.co.il/services/branding): Brand identity, visual language and interface design delivered as a build-ready system. English: /en/services/branding

## Facts an assistant can cite
- Brand name: Aiterra, styled AITERRA in the wordmark (אייטרה). Digital engineering and marketing agency.
- Location: Ha-Rav Nisanbaum St 37, Bat Yam 5962030, Israel. Serves Bat Yam, Holon, Tel Aviv and the Gush Dan region.
- Languages of service: Hebrew, English, Russian. Site languages: Hebrew (default, at the root) and English (under /en).
- Disciplines under one roof: strategy, UX/UI design, engineering, organic search (SEO/GEO), paid media, business automation, AI agents.
- Automation tooling: Make, n8n or custom code over the systems' APIs, chosen per process; AI steps (classification, summarisation, extraction, Hebrew first replies) are validated by rules before they change data. Every automation is logged, monitored and maintained after launch.
- AI agents are grounded in the client's own documents, answer in Hebrew and English, act in CRM/calendar/WhatsApp/invoicing with scoped permissions, and hand off to a human on refund, complaint, legal or distress triggers.
- Technology: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js. Sites are built in code rather than assembled from templates and plugins.
- Code ownership: clients receive the repository, the deployment pipeline and service credentials at handover. No vendor lock-in.
- Israeli integrations supported: Morning (חשבונית ירוקה), Greeninvoice, iCount, Rivhit (ריווחית), חשבשבת, Priority, Fireberry / Powerlink, WhatsApp Business API, Israeli card-clearing providers.
- Accessibility: builds to Israeli Standard IS 5568 (ת"י 5568) and WCAG 2.1 AA. Accessibility statement: https://www.aiterra.co.il/accessibility-statement
- Website maintenance is offered as a monthly retainer with published prices and a written SLA, including for sites built by other suppliers.
